messages.subject: Shiny Server 0.3.0 released (breaking changes!)
parts:
Hi folks,

I just published shiny-server 0.3.0 which has two important new behaviors, one of which is a breaking change:
  • You should no longer append ".shiny" to your application directories. This mechanism was confusing and unhelpful. Now Shiny Server just looks for a file named server.R in a folder to see if it's an application folder.
  • A new directive directory_index was added and it's enabled in the default config (but not enabled if you have a custom config file--you'll need to declare it yourself if you want it). This means if you have a folder that isn't part of an application and doesn't contain an index.html file, then browsing to that URL will list the contents of the folder.
If you want to upgrade, just running "npm install -g shiny-server" should do it.

-joe
